inferential_role: descriptive exploratory paired analysis; no production selection or adult confirmation

bootstrap.type: percentile participant-cluster bootstrap on fixed completed fit outcomes

limits: 8 participants; six overlapping-calibration CV folds are not independent replicates
one deterministic target-only seed does not estimate source training randomness
conditional risk has a smaller decision denominator when probabilities are missing
no missing imputation, outlier deletion, significance shopping, or unseen-population certification
all twelve declared arms are reported; no best-arm-only plot
bootstrap intervals describe conditional participant resampling uncertainty and do not establish adult efficacy
